svg.text: ONE OF THESE IS A SKILL. THE OTHER IS A COIN.
Every club, 2021–2026. Each dot is one club: how it did one season against how it did the next.
BEING GOOD PERSISTS. WINNING THE CLOSE ONES DOES NOT.
A club’s overall record explains 32% of its next one. Its one-run record explains 1%, and leans the wrong way.
